phase_name: Fixture Coverage for Every Recall-Failure Shape

objectives.description: Give make_plan_fixture an optional second parameter
Add WF/MF variants of each shape (plain, emphasis, table cell, line-wrapped, bracket-alone) for report and plan
Assert default-mode exit 0 and advisory message text for every malformed fixture
Drive all new cases through VALIDATE_SRC
Run whole suite; sweep real corpus and report flag count

approaches_tried.approach: Added a direct bounded-window-exceeded fixture (600-char filler, no mention, no bracket within window) in addition to the plan-named shapes
approaches_tried.reason: validates boundedness directly rather than only implicitly via the wrapped/bracket-alone shapes

notes: Added run_cfd_case/assert_cfd_silent/assert_cfd_empty/assert_cfd_unclosed helpers plus 5 shapes (plain inline, markdown emphasis, table cell, line-wrapped, closing-bracket-alone) x WF/MF x {report, plan} = 20 cases, plus mention-suppression (both types), hide-a-following-mark (report), and a direct bounded-window-exceeded case (report) -- 25 new assertions total driving the specific CFD label, plus the exit-code/--strict sub-assertions folded into the shared assert_cfd_empty/assert_cfd_unclosed helpers. Full suite: 108 PASSED, 0 FAILED. Confirmed the suite genuinely pins the check (not just inspects it): temporarily disabled the Phase 1 check in validate-artifact.sh (changed its gate to `if false; then`), re-ran the suite, and every CFD malformed-variant assertion correctly flipped to FAILED (19 failures), then restored the file byte-identical to its pre-disable state (diffed against a backup copy to confirm). shellcheck on the test file: only pre-existing SC1091 (sourced lib not shellcheck-followed) and SC2016 info-level findings (backtick/$ literals inside single-quoted fixture content) -- the same info-level pattern two pre-existing lines in this file already carry; no new warning/error severity introduced. Real-corpus sweep (via VALIDATE_SRC against the five actual report/plan files under specs/ carrying the token) reports flag count ZERO -- a triageable (empty) count, consistent with Phase 1's finding that mention-suppression closes every corpus flag.
